clips.title: The story
paras: Kaela's Update is an Alliance dispatch in the Stonetalon Mountains, carrying captured correspondence between frontline operatives. The gnome mage Gaxim Rustfizzle sends the adventurer back to Kaela Shadowspear with intercepted Venture Company letters. The intelligence helps the night elf Sentinels track the goblin cartel's destructive expansion across sacred lands.

After assisting the gnome mage Gaxim Rustfizzle in uncovering the movements of the Venture Company, he compiles recovered letters detailing the cartel's operations. Not one to pass up credit, Gaxim sends the player directly back to Kaela Shadowspear, the night elf Sentinel coordinator stationed near Windshear Crag. He makes sure to remind the courier to mention how his magical prowess made the investigation a success.

The Sentinels stationed in Stonetalon watch the crags with growing concern. While Horde forces contest the lower trails, the Venture Company's clear-cutting and mining apparatus pose an immediate ecological and tactical threat. The letters recovered by Gaxim grant Kaela valuable insights into the cartel's internal communications, bolstering the Alliance's defensive planning along the ridges.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
Make sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What can I do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You and Gaxim have done very well, friend. Thank you.
